claim_text: The NZDF says its website provider reported unauthorised access to its website systems on Nov 20
summary: The New Zealand Defence Force says that on Friday, Nov 20, its website provider notified it of 'unauthorised access to website systems', and that it removed the affected websites from service and began a forensic investigation.
detail: The NZDF calls it 'a cyber security incident affecting its public websites'. It does not name the provider.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice says so; RNZ and the NZ Herald report the same statement.

claim_text: A database for the Force4Families Defence Discounts scheme, holding names and email addresses, was accessed
summary: The NZDF says preliminary inquiries indicate that a database associated with its Force4Families Defence Discounts scheme was accessed, and that it includes the names and email addresses of registered users.
detail: RNZ describes the scheme as a discount scheme for Defence Force families.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice states it; RNZ and the NZ Herald report the same.

claim_text: The NZDF's website was still offline at our last check
summary: On Nov 25 at 11:30 PM ET (Nov 26 afternoon in New Zealand), nzdf.mil.nz showed only a temporary page saying the website is unavailable, with the NZDF's notice about the incident.
detail: The notice says the NZDF 'has taken the affected website offline'. Cyber Daily reported it still down on Nov 23.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own page says the website is temporarily unavailable; we read it ourselves at the time given.

claim_text: The NZDF has contacted people who may be affected and told the Privacy Commissioner
summary: The NZDF says it has contacted individuals whose information may have been affected, informed the Privacy Commissioner, engaged specialists to assess the extent of the incident and added monitoring and security measures.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice lists these steps; RNZ and the NZ Herald report them.

claim_text: Discount registrations are paused; career information and applications still work
summary: The NZDF's notice says career information and applications are still available, and that discount registrations and the discount directory are paused until the site returns.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice states it.

claim_text: The NZDF says the website will return after security testing, with no date given
summary: An NZDF spokesman told Cyber Daily on Nov 23 that the website 'remains offline while remediation continues' and that security testing and assurance work is under way 'before the website is returned to service'.
detail: No return date has been given in anything we read.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The NZDF's word, given to one outlet.

claim_text: How many people were affected is not known
summary: The NZDF has not said how many people were registered with the discount scheme or how many it has contacted. Cyber Daily reports no number.
label: Not established

claim_text: Whether anything beyond the discount database was reached is not known
summary: The NZDF says investigations remain ongoing and it is still determining 'the full extent of any information affected'.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice says the extent is not yet known.

claim_text: Who was behind it is not known, and no group has claimed it in what we read
summary: Cyber Daily reports that no threat actor has claimed responsibility. A cybersecurity executive told RNZ that a foreign intelligence agency could not be ruled out, but that a criminal gang could also be responsible.
detail: The expert's view is an opinion, not evidence. The NZDF has not said who was behind it. We did not open leak or dark-web sites.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: One outlet reports no claim of responsibility; the other reports an expert's speculation either way.

claim_text: Which provider was breached, and how, is not known
summary: The NZDF has not named its website provider or said how the access happened.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: None of the sources names the provider or the method.

claim_text: New Zealand's cyber security centre says recent attacks, including on the NZDF, do not appear to be linked
summary: RNZ reports that the deputy director of the National Cyber Security Centre said recent attacks, including on the Defence Force, don't appear to be linked. An expert told RNZ the NZDF and Forest & Bird attacks were likely a coincidence.
detail: The other incidents RNZ mentions include the Allied Media newspapers and the conservation group Forest & Bird.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: An official's view as reported by one outlet, and an expert's view in a second RNZ story; both from the same outlet.

claim_text: The NZDF advises users to watch for phishing and change reused passwords
summary: The NZDF asks people to be vigilant for phishing emails, verify any requests for personal information, change passwords that may have been used on the affected site and turn on multi-factor authentication.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The NZDF's own notice gives the advice.

claim_text: The NZDF is a government department made up of the Navy, Army and Air Force
summary: The New Zealand Government's directory lists the New Zealand Defence Force as a non-Public Service department under the Minister of Defence, with the Royal New Zealand Navy, the New Zealand Army and the Royal New Zealand Air Force.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The government's own directory page states it.
